Upon entry, apply 1 [ResultEnhancement] to all Sinners
Cannot be Staggered

passives.name: Thanks so much, everyone!

passives.name: In the end, I'm... just like the others?

passives.desc:
At 10+ [PowerOfLoveAndJustice] Count: lose 10 of its Count and gain 1 [PowerOfLoveAndJustice] Potency next turn

At 3 [PowerOfLoveAndJustice] Potency: when inflicting [Burst] Potency, inflict 1 [Burst] Count as well (2 times per turn)
passives.name: Power of Love and Justice

skills.desc:
[WhenUse] Base Power +1 for every 5 ([Burst] + [Sinking]) on target (max 2)
[WhenUse] Gain +10 [PowerOfLoveAndJustice]
skills.name: With Love!

descs: [OnSucceedAttack] If target has 10+ ([Burst] + [Sinking]), inflict 1 [Binding] next turn

skills.desc:

[WhenUse] Gain +10 [PowerOfLoveAndJustice] Count

Mainly targets 'The Knight of Despair'
Sub-targets the ally with the most [ColdBlackTear]
- If there are none, sub-targets the ally with the least HP
Inflicts 0 damage and does not activate the effects of [Sinking] and [ColdBlackTear] against allies

[WinDuel] Remove 1 [ColdBlackTear] from the sub-targeted ally
skills.name: Arcana Beats

skills.desc:
[StartBattle] Gain 1 [ChasingArcanahard]
[StartBattle] Gain 50 Shield
[StartBattle] Gain 20 [Aggro] next turn
skills.name: Looks Like I'll Have to Use This Power!

skills.desc:
[StartBattle] Gain 50 Shield
[StartBattle] Gain 20 [Aggro] next turn
[EndBattle] At 0 Shield HP, Retreats
skills.name: Chanting - Arcana Slave

skills.desc:
[CantDuel]
Deals damage only with Coin effects
Does not deal damage against Heart-breaking Sword, Heart-tearing Sword, and Heart-piercing Sword
Ends Turn when hitting enemies that has [WornOutKnight] and 600- HP
[EndBattle] Gain [UsedTooMuchPower]
skills.name: ARCANA SLAVE

name: The 6th Walpurgis Night: Hatred and Despair (Hard)

passives.desc:
Takes -50% damage from [Combustion], [Laceration], [Vibration], [Burst], and [Sinking] (rounded down)
If this unit hits with a Cracked [SuperCoin], it does not activate the target's [Sinking] effect (does not consume Count either)
passives.name: The Knight of Despair

passives.desc: Turn Start: if none of the swords on the field have [HelplessTear], apply [HelplessTear] to 1 random sword (once per turn; does not activate if a sword has [HelplessTear])
passives.name: River of Helpless Tears

passives.desc:
When Staggered for the first time, recover from Stagger next turn; then, gain 10 [Protection] and 500 Shield every turn
Summon Heart-breaking Sword, Heart-tearing Sword, and Heart-piercing Sword next turn
passives.name: Shared Sorrow

passives.desc:
Every time a sword pierces this unit, gain 1 [CollapsedPride], and [Protection] gained every turn is reduced by 3 while Shield HP gained every turn is reduced by 100
At 3 [CollapsedPride], this unit no longer gains [Protection] and Shield every turn, and instead becomes Staggered next turn and gains [WornOutKnight]
passives.name: Weathered Knight

passives.desc:
Turn End after getting Staggered for the first time: if there is a Sinner with 5+ [ColdBlackTear], uses an AoE Skill next turn
Turn End after getting Staggered for the first time: if all Sinners have [ColdBlackTear], gain [SignOfDespair] next turn
passives.name: Hollow Pride

passives.desc: When this unit is hit by ARCANA[TabExplain] SLAVE while it has [WornOutKnight] and is at less than 600 HP: does not lose HP below 5%, and kills itself at Turn End
passives.name: One Last Justice
